status: pre-registered before observing any updated-guide noise-augmentation result
purpose: test whether fixed train-only state corruption improves causal Transformer rollout robustness under corrected T1
evidence_boundary: MISATO-100 12D invariant-feature feasibility proxy; not atomic trajectory performance or an official score

training.checkpoint_policy: final epoch; no validation epoch selection
training.comparison: paired seed result from corrected-T1 no-noise Transformer run

promotion.primary: mean equal-macro T1/T2/T3 RMSE below paired no-noise Transformer
promotion.seed_consistency: beat paired no-noise Transformer in at least 2 of 3 seeds
promotion.T1_guard: mean T1 RMSE must not worsen by more than 2 percent

interpretation: A pass supports exposure-bias mitigation on invariant states only. The fixed sigma is inherited from the earlier preregistration and is not tuned after seeing corrected-protocol results.
